# U.S. Food and Drug Administration

> The FDA protects public health by regulating drugs, devices, foods, cosmetics, and biologics through industry systems, submissions, compliance monitoring, and safety oversight.

The FDA is the primary U.S. federal agency responsible for ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, food products, and cosmetics. The agency operates multiple industry-facing systems for regulatory submissions, facility registration, export certification, and adverse event reporting to maintain public health standards.

## Key Topics

- FDA Industry Systems
- Regulatory Compliance
- Drug Approval
- Medical Devices
- Food Safety
- Biologics Tracking
- Export Certification
- Adverse Event Reporting
- Facility Registration
- Prior Notice
- Import Oversight
- Recalls and Safety
- Bioterrorism Act of 2002
- BECATS
- CDER eCATS

## FDA Industry Systems & Submissions

- [FDA Industry Systems](https://www.access.fda.gov/): FDA Industry Systems portal for submissions, facility registration, and regulatory compliance

## FDA Main Portal

- [U.S. Food and Drug Administration](https://fda.gov/): FDA homepage: protecting public health through drug, device, food, and cosmetic safety
